PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 21, 2023
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER, BRIDGE ROOM,
  9:00 AM

Robert Livingstone, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Susan Redfield, Vice Chair  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner  Silissa Uriarte Smith, Commissioner

Brent Dennis, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL PUBLIC COMMENTS TO
  JENNIFER.ROBERTS@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee of the Month – November 2023

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  23-51585  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of November 16, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  23-51586  Recommendation to consider approval, or denial, of the fee waiver requests
  outlined in Attachment “A” in accordance with the Fee Waiver policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  23-51587  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record, conclude
  the public hearing, and adopt resolution amending fee and charges for parks and
  recreation programs and the use of public parks and recreation facilities for Fiscal
  Year 2024 to include a fee for the El Dorado Nature Center’s Guided School Tour
  Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  23-51588  Recommendation to recommend to the City Manager the approval of the MacArthur
  Park Rehabilitation Project as an improvement for public recreation at MacArthur
  Park, which meets a recreational need within the city. (District 6)

  Page 1 of 4
   PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 21, 2023
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER, BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00
  AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  23-51589  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute all documents necessary to issue a Use Permit to LARPBO: Los Angeles
  Responsible Pit Bull Owners, Inc., dba LARPBO Dog Training for the continued
  provision of on-leash dog training/handling classes at Heartwell Park for a term of
  two years, from December 1, 2023 to November 30, 2025, with one, two-year
  renewal option through November 30, 2027, at the discretion of the Director or
  designee. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  23-51590  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute all documents necessary to enter into an Agreement for Use of Facilities
  and Services with the Long Beach Unified School District for the facilitation of the
  District’s Work-Based Learning Community Classroom at the citywide senior
  program sites for a term of 5 years from February 1, 2024, through January 31,
  2029, with one three-year renewal option at the discretion of the Director. (Districts
  2,4,6,7,8,9)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  23-51591  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  extend Right-of-Entry Permit No. P-00256 and all documents necessary to Spohn
  Ranch, Inc., a California corporation, for a park amenity improvement at an existing
  skatepark located at Silverado Park, for a six-month term beginning December 1,
  2023 through May 31, 2024. (District 7)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  23-51592  Recommendation to receive and file the Director’s monthly highlights report, “We
  Create Community” and “Director’s Highlights” for December 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
